cc:Work.dc:description: Descriptive aggregation for this presentation, not category-level statistical results reported in the paper. The paper's two task categories: relevance (T1-T7) and consistency (T8-T10). First compute each participant's category accuracy percentage, total time in minutes, and mean available confidence on the 1-7 scale; then average the 18 participants equally within each condition. Shown: 12 differences from Linear. Positive time saved means less total time for the category. Categories contain 7 and 3 tasks, respectively. No tests, significance markers, or confidence intervals. Two missing confidence responses, T1 Source-guided and T10 Summary-guided, are excluded without imputation. Those participants' category confidence averages use 6 of 7 and 2 of 3 responses, respectively. Bars: Source-guided (mint), then Summary-guided (orange). Zero represents Linear; bar lengths show signed differences.
